scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to the isotropic affine locus with all nonzero singular values equal. It does not solve the general supercritical comass problem for unequal singular values. The proof starts from the exact graph-plane evaluation formula in the primary source, reduces the matrix optimization by the trace inequality and a pairwise smoothing identity, and solves the resulting one-variable problem exactly. The bundled symbolic checker replays the critical-point and closed-form algebra.
title: Exact isotropic supercritical comass profile for the Tsai--Wang form
